findings.title: No test pins the new 'moving' lock on Change folder…
findings.body: Moving `busy: busyNow` into `activeTransactionDeps()` is what makes `relocateRefusal` (`relocate.ts:24-25`) and `relocateActive` (`switch-transaction.ts:105-118`) refuse while a group move runs. But `relocate.test.ts` only types and sets `busy` as `"recording" | "exporting" | null` (lines 37, 54), and its lock tests (lines 107-113, 253-258) never use `"moving"`. Nothing would catch a regression back to the old wiring, where only `runSwitch` saw the move. Consider widening `setBusy` to `WorkspaceBusy` and adding a `"moving"` case, plus a `relocateRefusalMessage` case for `relocateMoving`.

findings.title: Change folder… is now also refused while a move runs; the docs list only recording and export
findings.body: This line says Change folder… is refused "while a recording or export runs". The spec's `workspaces:relocate` row (`specs/2026-10-29-several-workspaces-design.md:1302`) says the same. With this change, `relocateRefusal` also returns `moving` during a group move (`index.ts:346-347`, `relocate.ts:24-25`), and the user sees `relocateMoving`. Consider adding "or a move" in both places. The Part 2 paragraph would also work.

contracts.action: Change folder… (relocate) is refused while a group move holds the switch lock
contracts.equivalent_path: runSwitch → switchWorkspace, which already refused with `moving` through the same `busyNow`
contracts.before_after: Before: relocate's deps had no `busy`, or a host-only one, so a relocate could run during a move. After: `relocateRefusal` checks `busy()` before the picker opens and again after it, and `relocateActive` checks it before and after the windows prepare. All three return reason `moving`.
contracts.visible_effect: relocateRefusalMessage maps `moving` to `relocateMoving` ("Wait for the move to finish before changing a workspace's folder."), shown in the dialog's alert. en and es both carry the key.
contracts.failure_mode: A move that starts while the picker is open is caught by the second `relocateRefusal` in `relocateWorkspace`. `moveRun` is cleared in `finally`, so the lock cannot stay stuck after a move that throws.

thread_replies.reply: Confirmed: the catch now returns `refuseAll(refusalOfError(error))` (index.ts:215-217) instead of always `stale`.
Confirmed: a rejected `loadDeviceId` clears `deviceId` before rethrowing (index.ts:174-177), so the next group retries.
Confirmed: the `skipped` doc now says only Stop fills it, and that a whole-group refusal goes to `failed` (workspaces.ts:252-256). This matches `refuseAll`.
Confirmed: `chipLabel`, `newWorkspace` and `reason_stale` now say "espacio de trabajo" (es.json:2639, 2645, 2685).

structuredOutput.summary: This round moves `busy: busyNow` into the shared active-transaction deps. Change folder… is now refused with a new `moving` reason during a group move, at the same three checks as recording and export. The `moving` reason has its message in en and es and is mapped in relocate-copy. The test assertion on “Move to” matches the en text, and the spec's IPC table lost no rows in the reformat. Two minor points: no test covers the `moving` refusal on relocate, and the backlog and spec still say relocate is refused only during a recording or export. All four earlier threads on these files are addressed.
